policy.use: Static profiles classify sector drivers and peer baskets. Only completed candles and point-in-time events public by the simulated click may influence V6.
policy.direction_rule: Directional labels use only intrinsic information available at publication. Ambiguous or mixed announcements are NEUTRAL. Subsequent stock-price action is never used.

events.notes: The policy outcome was mixed for equities; the archive uses the next-session-open rule rather than inferring an intraday market timestamp.

events.title: India April retail inflation rose to 3.48%, below the Reuters poll forecast while energy risks remained elevated
